name: Better Zen Start Page
description: A sophisticated start page fix for Zen. Features a custom animated logo and a subtle transparent fade-in background.
author: aree6

zen.fix.newtab.name: Start Page Logo
zen.fix.newtab.description: Displays the animated 'Welcome to a calmer internet' logo on empty tabs.

zen.fix.fade.name: Fade In Transparent Background
zen.fix.fade.description: Adds a subtle, sophisticated gradient fade from the left side of the browser.

zen.fix.tabs.name: Transparent Tabs & Dot Indicator
zen.fix.tabs.description: Makes inactive tabs transparent and adds a dot indicator for visibility. (Default: Off)

zen.fix.pending.name: Pending Tab Status
zen.fix.pending.description: Dims unloaded tabs and adds a moon icon 🌙. (Default: Off)

zen.fix.cleanui.name: Clean UI & No Bookmarks
zen.fix.cleanui.description: Hides the bookmarks toolbar and removes harsh tab borders. (Default: Off)

zen.fix.essentials.name: Essentials Grid Layout
zen.fix.essentials.description: Optimizes the Essentials grid and icon sizing. (Default: Off)
